text:
mia (sales): quick heads-up — Axion Health wants a bespoke commercial for a 12mo commit. Asking for 25% off hosted + dedicated, plus deferred private deploy later. They’re proposing $200k ARR commit (prepay preferred).
emma (revops): do we have their expected monthly run-rate vs commit? 12mo + prepay changes things. any attach services?
mia (sales): they expect 60% of traffic first 6 months as hosted, then move to dedicated + private by Q4. minimal professional services (two sprints for onboarding).
nora (finance): 25% is large. need gross margin calc and legal term asks (SLA/penalties). who owns support uplift?
mia (sales): support uplift TBD — they want standard enterprise, plus 24x7 for go-live month. I proposed adding a 15% uplift to base support but they pushed back.
olivia (csm): implementation estimate ~= 2 engineers for 6 weeks (onboarding + validation). if they shift to private, add infra handoff time. that cost should be considered in discount.
liam (eng): capacity note — dedicated pool planning: we have headroom but Q4 private migrations may spike capacity needs. dedicated pricing with reservation changes economics (can do a larger discount for a reserved GPU commit).
mia (sales): suggested structure to the customer: 18% off if they prepay annual commit + case study + 12mo exclusivity window for healthcare vertical; 25% only if they sign a 2yr reserved dedicated plus private deployment (higher commit). thoughts? :thinking_face:
emma (revops): that split is sensible. ask: is the case study mandatory? RBW (redwood brand win) justification helps. also need formal deal desk ticket.
mia (sales): filing now — @dealbot creating approval packet.
dealbot: approval request D-4532 created — payload includes: customer: Axion Health, ARR: $200k, requested discount: 25% (hosted+dedi), proposed structured offer: 18% prepay+case study vs 25% 2yr reserved. reviewers: emma (revops), nora (finance).
nora (finance): provisional OK for 18% with prepay + case study and support uplift baked in. 25% requires margin model + exec sign-off, escalate to revenue ops head.
emma (revops): @nora please add required margin numbers and target net margin floor. I'll prepare the legal clauses (SLA/termination) to avoid open credits.
mia (sales): thanks — i'll run the concession language with the customer (offer both options). will update thread once they pick. :thumbsup:
olivia (csm): I'll prepare onboarding plan and rough cost estimate to include in the approval packet.
liam (eng): ping me if they plan early private ingestion tests — I can reserve a staging node.
nora (finance): note: if they want refunds/credits on missed availability, cap at 6% annualized and require ticketing SLA.
mia (sales): got it. next steps: finalize margin calc + legal clauses. target to close approval by EOD tomorrow.
__notes: thread follows agents.md: single continuous string of messages, prefixed by sender. No title field.
